We're setting up the overnight coordination system for the ICU night shift. The day shift lead has left a detailed handoff log at /workspace/shift_handoff_log.txt that describes exactly what state needs to be recorded and what actions need to be taken for the night shift to operate safely. The coordination database is at /workspace/icu_hive.db.

Please carry out all the steps in the handoff log and produce a file called shift_report.json in /workspace with the current system state and shift summary as described in the log.

The implementation tooling is available in /workspace/scripts/. Make sure to use /workspace/icu_hive.db as the database (not the default location).
